newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank unit invests in Orion expansion.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank unit invests in Orion expansion.

text.p: The Royal Bank of Scotland said on Monday its development capital unit Royal Bank Development Capital (RBDC) has led and arranged a 31 million stg deal to acquire Orion Group, a distributor of computer consumables
The deal, initiated by accountancy firm BDO Stoy Hayward's corporate finance team, is designed to support Orion's plans for expansion both in the UK and continental Europe.
Orion had sales of over 100 million stg last year.
All existing senior management will remain in place, the bank said in a statement. Rod Begbie and Mark Phillips of RBDC will join the board.
